adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` running the scheduled feed poll inline: `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` synchronously does `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and `SimpleRSS.parse` and iterates all items. That is a concrete performance/architecture concern (doing a whole-feed fetch/parse just to satisfy a single embed URL check) and can tie up the worker executing the retrieve, even if it’s not a correctness/security defect.
